name: Ray-casting with Reeling
summary: Ray-casting where the selected object can be reeled in or out along the ray with buttons, like a fishing line.
howItWorks: Selection is ordinary ray-casting. Once attached to the ray, the object can be moved nearer or farther along it with two buttons, which plain ray-casting cannot do.

relationships.note: Adds reeling for depth control after selection.
